comparison.objective: Remove a locked terminal; record hangs a holder on two keyhole studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Release a single internal tab and withdraw versus align two openings over two heads, push behind them, drop into narrow slots, and release under load.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without collateral damage versus both shanks bearing at their slot ends with the holder released, upright, still, and sustained. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests simultaneous dual-feature engagement and gravity seating, the inverse mechanics of selective latch release.
